question: Evaluate: 16 + 9 ÷ 3 - 3 × 3
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: 16 + 9 ÷ 3 - 3 × 3

**Formula used:**

Follow BODMAS: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division/Multiplication (left to right), Addition/Subtraction (left to right)

**Calculation:**

Expression: 16 + 9 ÷ 3 - 3 × 3

⇒ 16 + 3 - 9 

⇒ 19 - 9 

⇒ 10

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
